{'text': 'iOS 27.2 beta 4 今日正式向開發者推出，是次更新包括 Apple Music 嘅全新 app 圖示，以及音樂 app 內其他設計更新。', 'paragraph_context': 'iOS 27.2 beta 4 debuted today for developers, and the update includes a new app icon for Apple Music alongside other design updates in the Music app.'}

{'text': '煥新嘅音樂 app 圖示、分頁欄更新同資料庫微調喺 iOS 27.2 登場', 'paragraph_context': 'Refreshed Music app icon, tab bar updates, and Library tweaks arrive in iOS 27.2'}

{'text': 'Apple 正處於 Apple Music 品牌形象逐步更新嘅過程之中。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple appears in the midst of a gradual branding refresh for Apple Music.'}

{'text': '該公司最近推出咗一個全新嘅 Apple Music 標誌，並開始喺更多地方出現，包括上星期喺 iOS 27.2 beta 3 入面亮相。', 'paragraph_context': 'The company recently debuted an all-new Apple Music logo that’s started spreading to more places, including an appearance in iOS 27.2 beta 3 last week.'}

{'text': '而今日隨住 beta 4 推出，iOS 27.2 嘅音樂 app 都換上咗新圖示。', 'paragraph_context': 'And now today with beta 4, iOS 27.2 has a new app icon for Music too.'}

{'text': '如上所見，新圖示移除咗品牌原本嘅色彩。預設係白色圖示配黑色音樂標誌，而喺深色模式就係黑色配白色標誌。', 'paragraph_context': 'As seen above, the new app icon removes color from the branding. It’s a white icon with black music logo by default, and in dark mode it’s black with a white logo.'}

{'text': 'GoldGrapes 嘅熱門留言', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by GoldGrapes'}

{'text': '實在太沉悶，完全唔似 Apple 嘅設計風格。', 'paragraph_context': "It's extremely dull. Not a redesign I'd associate with Apple."}

{'text': '反而令人諗起第一次整 app 嘅人用嘅圖示。🤔', 'paragraph_context': 'It brings to mind an icon used by someone working on their first app. 🤔'}

{'text': '除咗呢個改動之外，iOS 27.2 嘅音樂 app 喺分頁欄嘅當前選用分頁採用咗藍色，與以往嘅紅色／粉紅色品牌風格形成強烈對比。音樂 app 嘅小工具同樣由標誌性嘅紅色／粉紅色背景，改為簡潔嘅黑色背景。', 'paragraph_context': 'Alongside this change, the Music app in iOS 27.2 now uses blue in the tab bar for the currently active tab—a stark shift from the previous red/pink branding. Widgets for the Music app similarly now use simple black backgrounds instead of the iconic red/pink.'}

{'text': '此外，你嘅資料庫入面，「播放列表」、「專輯」、「藝人」同「歌曲」等唔同分類嘅清單，都已經移除色彩，改為黑白設計。', 'paragraph_context': 'Additionally, in your Library, the list of different sections like Playlists, Albums, Artists, and Songs have all had color removed in favor of a black-and-white design.'}

{'text': '你點睇 iOS 27.2 嘅 Apple Music 設計更新？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅睇法。', 'paragraph_context': 'What do you think of the Apple Music design updates in iOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.'}

{'text': 'Apple Music 月費為 11.99 美元，你亦可以透過 Apple One 組合訂閱。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Music is available for $11.99/month, or you can get it as part of the Apple One bundle.'}
